state_definition.q: SE(2) logarithm of an already completed 0.1-second planar pose increment, divided by its duration
state_definition.initial_state: two actual final warmup endpoints twenty ticks apart; measurement begins at the second endpoint
state_definition.future_samples: every consecutive 200Hz pose sample; no gap, duplicate or future endpoint
state_definition.partial_terminal_interval: retain the actual tail and last completed q separately; never pad, query again or fabricate q
state_definition.observation_slots: indices 2:5 carry completed q; remaining time is real seconds divided by 90
state_definition.compatibility: same 61D shape does not permit legacy obs-v7 or obs-v8-t90 checkpoints
limitations: This state is not instantaneous body velocity, angular velocity or the requested command.
Completed q is observable after its interval, but sufficiency as a Markov state is not proven.
Old saved traces lack the needed earlier warmup endpoint; future truth cannot repair it.
A frozen motion model SHA256, state version, observation version and time profile must be bound together.

saved_support_review.scope: 18 exposed measurement traces; warmup commands excluded; not independent new data
saved_support_review.interpretation: Marginal ranges are descriptive only; they do not define joint support or a deployment envelope.
saved_support_review.affine_models: Three held-out diagnostic models remain unselected. Nonzero intercepts must not be extrapolated into measured zero-command behavior or compensation commands.

reference_cost_preparation.reference_program: declare initial pose/q, waypoint/heading switching, applied command bounds and termination before generating a trajectory
reference_cost_preparation.geometry: same raw obstacles, footprint and delta counted once; validate the whole simulated path, including turns and boundary
reference_cost_preparation.nominal_cost_J: sum frozen positive mechanical power model(applied command) times actual duration, including any terminal partial interval
reference_cost_preparation.internal_budget_consumption_J: (1 + frozen alpha) times nominal_cost_J; physical positive mechanical work logged separately
reference_cost_preparation.time_rule: one common 90-second candidate; no L/90 substitution or automatic budget doubling
reference_cost_preparation.failure_rule: retain unreachable, unsafe, out-of-support and incomplete programs as failures; do not drop difficult maps

downstream_pending: choose and validate a physically sensible motion model over its declared state/command domain using a separately specified finite protocol
implement real warmup sampling and a state/model-bound candidate nominal environment; keep original instantaneous measurements
implement the reference command program and its J costs after motion-model identity is explicit
pre-register 90-second residual applicability and independent data separation; original alpha/delta remain frozen
